notes:
session 1 recap (pasted from the group chat)

Brakka: Held the bridge, troll ran off, kept the goblins in line till the watch took them. Won two in the pit, lost the third to the champ — worth it.

Wick: bro rode an ox into a troll fight, lost my dagger to the river, got told the troll works for a "Toll King" 💀 also lost the party's 40g rigging dice (in my defense i was GOOD at it), Steve the ox lost a race by sitting down, and I got banned from a pie tent. 10/10 session, no notes

Maren: maren recap: rooted 3/4 goblins in place with entangle, healed brakka back up, thorn-whipped the last goblin into the burning railing (troll noped into the river lol), then patched up the surrendered goblins anyway bc soft heart. cinderford was cozy - sold out of honey, got 2nd place in the bake-off with a lavender honey loaf, and adopted a stable cat 🐈 steve the ox is now emotionally attached to me

Tovin: Tovin's night: torched a troll, lost my pit bet, and apparently 'read very well' by a woman who wants a year of my dreams for some king's secret. Also I may have quietly tidied up a loose end on the bridge — don't ask Luz about it.

Luz: Tonight Luz heal Brakka full HP after the troll fight (Cure Wounds clutch 😅), and she catch Tovin killing a goblin that was surrender, not happy about that at all. Then Ember Festival was so pretty, Luz lead the dawn blessing at the temple and whole square kneel, I nearly cry lol ✨

GM: the troll was WAY out of their league (hill troll vs lvl 3s) and they still drove it off. next session: the Toll King. rules q for next time - can Wick ride Steve as a mount without Mounted Combatant? also someone owes me pizza money

mechanics.effect: Once per long rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you may use your reaction to immediately regain 1 hit point and gain advantage on your next attack roll against the creature that dealt the damage.

lineage.rationale: Repeatedly engaged in high-stakes duels, showing resilience and a refusal to yield even when losing.

entry.name: Hexblade: The Quiet End

mechanics.effect: Make a melee attack against a creature that has surrendered or is otherwise helpless. On a success, deal 1d8 necrotic damage and the target is Frightened until the start of your next turn. This action can only be used against targets who have explicitly yielded or are unable to defend themselves.

malignance.drawback: Tovin suffers a -2 penalty to Persuasion checks when attempting to negotiate with or show mercy to any creature, as the act of killing the surrendered has become a compulsive habit rather than a tactical choice.

lineage.rationale: The event of killing a surrendering goblin indicates a pattern of inflicting harm beyond what is required for survival or victory, fitting the definition of cruelty.

entry.system_equivalent: Warlock Eldritch Invocation (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

evidence: Tovin torched a troll.

entry.name: Hexblade: Pyre's Kiss

mechanics.effect: Make a spell attack against one creature within 30 feet. On a success, deal 2d6 fire damage. If the target is a Large or larger creature, the fire ignites their clothing or fur, causing them to take 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of their turns until they extinguish the flames.

lineage.rationale: Successfully using fire magic to defeat a troll demonstrates a reliable affinity for elemental destruction.

entry.system_equivalent: Rank 1 Elemental Spell (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))
